visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long brown hair smiles brightly, holding a smartphone that displays Google image search results for a traditional Chinese dish called 'Ants Climbing a Tree'. The background is a clean, modern indoor living room featuring a blue abstract painting and soft indoor lighting. (2) She holds up a large clear plastic bag filled with green celery sticks, gesturing towards the camera as she speaks. The setting remains the well-lit home interior, showing a kitchen counter area behind her as she presents the ingredient. (3) A high-angle flat-lay shot on a white counter reveals a white plate, two long celery stalks, a jar of Jif peanut butter, and a small red box of Sun-Maid raisins. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the textures of the food items. (4) Close-up shots follow, showing the woman's hands using a silver table knife to spread thick, brown peanut butter into the natural groove of a celery stick. Her movements are deliberate, filling the length of the green stalk on a white plate. (5) Her hand carefully places small, dark, wrinkled raisins at regular intervals along the peanut butter layer on the celery. The close-up framing emphasizes the contrast between the green celery stalks, brown peanut butter, and black raisins. (6) Two completed 'Ants on a Log' snacks are shown in a close-up, sitting side-by-side on a white plate. The camera angle is slightly tilted, capturing the detail of the raisins resting on the smooth peanut butter surface. (7) The woman and a young man wearing a blue graphic t-shirt stand side-by-side in a bright room, laughing and holding their prepared snacks. They toast the celery sticks together before preparing to take a bite. (8) Both characters bite into the celery sticks simultaneously; a close-up captures the woman laughing as a long, thin celery fiber pulls away from her mouth. Their facial expressions show genuine amusement and high-energy interaction. (9) The pair continues to laugh and talk, holding the half-eaten celery sticks toward the camera lens. The background shows a domestic kitchen setting with soft sunlight streaming in, creating a warm and casual atmosphere.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A female voice speaks with a high pitch and friendly, animated prosody, introducing a culinary topic. A cheerful, mid-tempo acoustic guitar-driven BGM plays consistently in the background, providing a light and upbeat atmosphere for the presentation. (2) A sharp, textured rustling sound of a plastic bag is clearly audible as the speaker handles a package of celery sticks. The female narration continues with consistent energy, moderate speech rate, and very clear articulation throughout this instructional segment. (3) A distinct metallic scraping sound occurs as a knife spreads creamy peanut butter onto a celery stick. The acoustic guitar BGM remains steady, maintaining a light rhythmic feel while the speaker describes the process with high positive valence and engagement. (4) Multiple sharp, percussive crunching sounds are heard as people bite into the raw celery sticks. Spontaneous laughter from both the primary female speaker and a secondary male voice fills the audio space, indicating high emotional arousal and joy. (5) The female narration concludes with a direct question to the audience, shifting her pitch slightly upward at the end. The acoustic BGM maintains its upbeat tempo before a final fade-out, while background chatter and laughter continue softly.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Ingredient Intro -> Preparation -> Tasting -> Closing Question
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves to introduce the classic American childhood snack 'Ants on a Log' to a likely Chinese-speaking audience by drawing a humorous comparison with the traditional Chinese dish 'Ants Climbing a Tree' (蚂蚁上树). Through a step-by-step tutorial and a live tasting with a partner, the creator highlights the literal interpretation of the name in the American version versus the metaphorical name in the Chinese version, aiming to entertain and educate viewers about cultural snack differences.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: While brand-name products (Jif, Sun-Maid) are clearly visible, they appear to be used as standard household items for a casual tutorial rather than a paid promotion.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively uses side-by-side bilingual subtitles to reach a cross-cultural audience. The inclusion of a male partner for the tasting segment adds social proof and enhances the energetic, relatable vlog style.
